title: THE ROCK OPERA // RHAEGAR'S DISTORTION PEDAL
narrative: In the Great Hall of Winterfell, Abel the singer tunes his silver-stringed harp. He stomps on a secret hollow stone in the hearth. A primitive acoustic distortion amplifier hums to life. He strikes an electric E-minor chord that rattles the rafters. 'You thought Rhaegar died at the Trident?' he roars, tossing his silver-blonde glamor into the crowd. 'Westeros wasn't ready for progressive metal! The Song of Ice and Fire was an 18-minute concept album with a seven-minute drum solo!'
